text: The German KapMuG does not relieve trial judges of deciding the legal issues in every individual case, so it remains administratively burdensome even though its model case judgment binds the trial courts.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Richard W. Painter, Forum Competition and Choice of Law Competition in Securities Law after Morrison v. National Austral (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2029983

isBasedOn.name: Forum Competition and Choice of Law Competition in Securities Law after Morrison v. National Austral

abstract: The KapMuG, how- ever, does not discharge the trial judges from addressing the legal issues in each and every case individually.

value: German model case proceedings for capital markets claims
